dialogues.jp: ぽかぽかと暖かい陽光のなか、商店街を歩く。
dialogues.en:
With the sun's warm rays beating down onto my body, I stroll
down the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
With the sun's warm rays beating down onto my body, I stroll
down the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
日曜の商店街は、どこも大｛にぎ／賑｝わいだった。その
中を、目的もなくぼんやりと歩く俺。
dialogues.en:
On Sundays, the shopping district is always bustling with
activity. Within that, I aimlessly walk around.
dialogues.text:
On Sundays, the shopping district is always bustling with
activity. Within that, I aimlessly walk around.

dialogues.jp:
店頭に飾られたいくつもの商品が、瞳に映って
は消えていく……。
dialogues.en:
A nicely-decorated roadside shop only grabbed the attention
of my eyes for a second.
dialogues.text:
A nicely-decorated roadside shop only grabbed the attention
of my eyes for a second.

dialogues.jp: 「うーむ……かったりいな」
dialogues.en: "Fuu.... nothing to do."
dialogues.text: "Fuu.... nothing to do."

dialogues.jp:
本屋とＣＤだけ覗いて、後はただ人ごみの中を
歩くだけ。
dialogues.en:
After paying a visit to a bookshop and CD shop, I return to
the strolling masses.
dialogues.text:
After paying a visit to a bookshop and CD shop, I return to
the strolling masses.

dialogues.jp:
こうなると、公園で鳩でも追いかけていた方が、
まだましか。
dialogues.en:
From all the boredom, I get a sudden urge to go to the park
and chase down the pidgeons there.
dialogues.text:
From all the boredom, I get a sudden urge to go to the park
and chase down the pidgeons there.

dialogues.jp: 「他に買うものでもあればな」
dialogues.en: "Maybe I can buy something while I'm here...?"
dialogues.text: "Maybe I can buy something while I'm here...?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか必要なモノがなかったかと、家にある雑
貨を頭の中で検索してみる。
dialogues.en:
Do I need to buy anything? I searched my brain for
provisions a household needs...
dialogues.text:
Do I need to buy anything? I searched my brain for
provisions a household needs...

dialogues.jp: トイレットペーパー、ティッシュ、茶菓子……。
dialogues.en: Toilet paper, tissues, sweets....
dialogues.text: Toilet paper, tissues, sweets....

dialogues.jp:
逆から｛うな／唸｝っても、順番をずらしても、在庫管理
は完璧だった。
dialogues.en:
With a hum, my brain works takes inventory control
perfectly, revealing no needed supplies.
dialogues.text:
With a hum, my brain works takes inventory control
perfectly, revealing no needed supplies.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、突然買いに行く羽目にならないように、
　どれも１０個以上、予備を備蓄してるからな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, maybe I should buy like 10 extra of each, for
emergency supplies."
dialogues.text:
"Well, maybe I should buy like 10 extra of each, for
emergency supplies."

dialogues.jp:
機会がある度に、ついでにと買っていたら、い
つの間にかこんなになってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention it'd be a great way to get out of provision
shopping for awhile.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention it'd be a great way to get out of provision
shopping for awhile.

dialogues.jp:
これ以上買うと、｛さすが／流石｝に音夢大魔人さまがお怒
りになってしまう。
dialogues.en:
Then again, if I do something like that, I'd have to prepare
myself for the wrath of Demon Nemu...
dialogues.text:
Then again, if I do something like that, I'd have to prepare
myself for the wrath of Demon Nemu...

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ俺にどうしろと？」
dialogues.en: "Well then, what should I do?"
dialogues.text: "Well then, what should I do?"

dialogues.jp: このまま、ただ人ごみに揉まれてろとでも？
dialogues.en: Rummage through someone else's garbage out of boredom?
dialogues.text: Rummage through someone else's garbage out of boredom?

dialogues.jp:
「そう言えば、さくらからチョコが届いていたっ
　けか……？」
dialogues.en:
"...Speaking of which, maybe I should buy some chocolates to
send to Sakura?"
dialogues.text:
"...Speaking of which, maybe I should buy some chocolates to
send to Sakura?"

dialogues.jp:
わざわざ後で買いに来るのは面倒臭いな。それ
に今できることは、今のうちにやっておいた方
がいいだろう。
dialogues.en:
Just window shopping is tiresome. It'd be better if I had a
goal to work towards.
dialogues.text:
Just window shopping is tiresome. It'd be better if I had a
goal to work towards.

dialogues.jp: うん、先送りは良くない。
dialogues.en: Yeah, I won't postpone it any longer.
dialogues.text: Yeah, I won't postpone it any longer.

dialogues.jp:
「よし、せっかくだから早めに買っておいてや
　るか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, time to finally buy something."
dialogues.text: "Alright, time to finally buy something."

dialogues.jp:
『チョコＩＮゼリー』
『お買い得　４０個＋４個』
『ミルクたっぷりフルーツ果実入り』
dialogues.en:
"Choco-in-Jelly" "Buy 40 get 4 free" "Milk and Fruit & Nut
flavours available"
dialogues.text:
"Choco-in-Jelly" "Buy 40 get 4 free" "Milk and Fruit & Nut
flavours available"

dialogues.jp:
当然、この時期にホワイトデーのチョコなど売っ
ていない。
dialogues.en:
Of course, at this period they haven't started selling White
Day chocolates yet.
dialogues.text:
Of course, at this period they haven't started selling White
Day chocolates yet.

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、あの値段のものを普段置いても、売れ
　んだろうからな）
dialogues.en:
"(Well, at least in the off-season, the prices are
cheaper.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Well, at least in the off-season, the prices are
cheaper.)"

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きめの板チョコを手に取る。
dialogues.en: I picked up a huge "board" of chocolate.
dialogues.text: I picked up a huge "board" of chocolate.

dialogues.jp: 『５０パーセント増量　業務用』
dialogues.en: "50% more chocolates, for business use"
dialogues.text: "50% more chocolates, for business use"

dialogues.jp: 「……対費用効果は抜群だが」
dialogues.en: "...Cost-vs-effectiveness takes precedence for me."
dialogues.text: "...Cost-vs-effectiveness takes precedence for me."

dialogues.jp: 流石に、ただの板チョコはあんまりだ。
dialogues.en: I start looking for a more normal box of chocolates.
dialogues.text: I start looking for a more normal box of chocolates.

dialogues.jp:
板チョコを棚に戻すと、その下の『ＮＥＷ』と
書かれたチョコを手に取る。
dialogues.en:
As I put the chocolate board back on it's shelf, under it, I
see chocolates with the word "NEW" written above them.
dialogues.text:
As I put the chocolate board back on it's shelf, under it, I
see chocolates with the word "NEW" written above them.

dialogues.jp: 「これでいいだろう。『ＮＥＷ』だし」
dialogues.en: "This should be good, if they're "NEW" and all."
dialogues.text: "This should be good, if they're "NEW" and all."

dialogues.jp:
なにが『ＮＥＷ』なのか分からないアーモンド
チョコを掴み、財布を漁りながらレジに向かっ
た。
dialogues.en:
With the almond chocolate with unknown "NEW"ness in hand, I
head to the register while rummaging through my wallet.
dialogues.text:
With the almond chocolate with unknown "NEW"ness in hand, I
head to the register while rummaging through my wallet.

dialogues.jp: ◆バレンタインのお返し◆
dialogues.en: ◆Return Valentine◆
dialogues.text: ◆Return Valentine◆

dialogues.jp: 何となく商店街をぶらつく。
dialogues.en: For some reason, I ended up at the shopping district.
dialogues.text: For some reason, I ended up at the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
ふと思い出して、さくらのバレンタインのお返
しを買う事にした。
dialogues.en:
I offhandedly remembered about Sakura's Valentine's gift,
and bought something to return the favour.
dialogues.text:
I offhandedly remembered about Sakura's Valentine's gift,
and bought something to return the favour.
